summary: Full backend + frontend regression for KKT Real Estate ERP Phase 1. 31/31 pytest cases pass covering health/openapi, auth gates & error envelope, JWT login for all 5 seeded users, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection + logout, account lockout (new throwaway user, 5 wrong passwords -> 423, correct password still 423), RBAC + project scope (projectadmin restricted to SGH, sales/employee enforcement), flat-type auto area + area hierarchy validation, block creation (32 flats, numbering + floor-rise pricing verified), regenerate 409 on Hold, booked manual 409, add floors (36 total), bulk price, block grid, audit log flat.status entries, master deactivate 409/200 usage checks, pagination/search/dashboard parity, users self-deactivate 409, system role delete 409, permissions grouping, settings bank account masking (endswith 4433, no plaintext leak). Frontend playwright verified: login page split layout, demo buttons, admin dashboard stat-total renders, SGH->Blocks->Tower A loads inventory-grid, grid-flat-A-802 opens flat drawer, Hold button changes data-status to 'Hold'. Audit log page shows flat.status entries. Master Data -> Flat Types -> master-new-btn opens form; ft-room-0-length=12, width=10 auto-computes area to 120. Employee sidebar shows only Dashboard/Projects/Inventory/Master Data and master-new-btn is hidden. Project Admin (projectadmin@kkt.in) sees only SGH in Projects list. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: master.py is 336 LoC and growing - consider splitting the dynamic factory (register) into a separate module for maintainability.
Settings bank_account.account_number validation uses min_length=4 which is permissive; consider enforcing numeric-only and length>=9 for Indian bank accounts.

routers/auth.py _rate_limit uses an in-memory defaultdict keyed by IP - won't survive multi-worker/replica deployments; fine for single-process but should be documented or moved to Mongo/Redis before scaling.

deps.get_current_user sets user['permissions'] as a Python set which is not JSON-serialisable; auth.me manually sorts it to list but any accidental return of the whole user object elsewhere would 500 on serialization. Safe today but fragile.
test_credentials: Seeded users (password Kkt@12345): admin@kkt.in, projectadmin@kkt.in, accounts@kkt.in, sales@kkt.in, employee@kkt.in. Throwaway lockout users created with 'locktest_<hex>@kkt.in' prefix left in DB (deactivated once locked).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a new SGH block (code T<hex>, 36 flats after +1 floor), one new TEST_FT_* flat type (deactivated), new TEST_RT_* room type (deactivated), locktest_* user (locked). Dashboard total is now 112 (76 seeded + 36 from new block).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard inventory.total has drifted from the original 76 to 112 due to test block creation; adjust any 'expected 76' assertions. New block uses pattern {block}-{floor}{pos2} with floor_start 1. Lockout fixture leaves user locked for 15 min - use fresh uuid-based email. Rate limit 10 logins/min per IP meant login responses are cached in a module-level dict; drop cache entries if testing refresh/logout behaviour.
